en.title: Generate Matrix B
en.description:
In row-major order, write the prefix sums of the flattened matrix A back into a matrix B of the same size.

This site's standard I/O format and supplementary bounds follow this problem's statement.
en.input: The first line contains m n (1≤m,n≤1000, mn≤2×10^5), followed by m lines of n integers each (−10^9≤Aij≤10^9).
en.output: Output m lines, each with n prefix sums.
en.explanation: Accumulate one global running sum row by row and column by column; each position contains exactly all elements of the rows before it plus the elements to its left in the current row. Time O(mn), extra space O(n) for output.
hints: Accumulate one global running sum row by row and column by column; each position contains exactly all elements of the rows before it plus the elements to its left in the current row. Time O(mn), extra space O(n) for output.
